answer_1.quote: As one of the major natural language generation tasks, automatic summarization has been studied for decades... we introduce a new abstractive Email Thread Summarization (EMAILSUM) dataset.
answer_1.outputs: short (<30 words) and long (<100 words) abstractive summaries of email threads

answer_2.quote: We use the rouge score package and report F1 scores. BERTScore goes beyond n-gram overlap to provide contextualized semantic similarity.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk... annotators rate the "salience" and "faithfulness" of model-generated summaries on a 5-point Likert scale and perform pairwise comparisons.
answer_4.guideline: Rate salience and faithfulness on a 5-point Likert scale; compare summaries to determine which is more salient, more faithful, and overall higher quality.
